hook: You've rephrased the same prompt 6 times and the AI still sounds like it's writing a LinkedIn post for a robot.
caption:
You've rephrased the same prompt 6 times and the AI still sounds like it's writing a LinkedIn post for a robot.

Here's what's actually happening.

AI doesn't know if you're the person who thinks in bullet points before you think in sentences. It doesn't know you hate analogies involving sports. It doesn't know you need the blunt version first, then the nuanced one — not the other way around.

So it guesses. And it guesses toward the middle. Safe. Generic. Technically correct and completely useless to you.

The fix isn't a better prompt. It's a better starting point.

When AI knows your thinking style — how you process, what you skip, what makes you re-read something three times in frustration — it stops guessing.

That's the whole idea behind BootFile. One profile that travels with you. Built around how YOUR brain actually works, not how the average user's brain works.

Because there is no average user. There's just you, rewriting the same prompt for the seventh time.

Link in bio to build yours.
